title: He Is Not To Call Attention
summary: Seva is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: He is not to call attention to himself in any way
lifeApplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: He is not to call attention to himself in any way
source.lifeApplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.

evidence.coreClaim: He is not to call attention to himself in any way
evidence.turn: Seva becomes transformative when the self stops trying to be seen through it.
